164: Young William Shakespeare is forced to stage his latest comedy, 'Romeo and Ethel, the Pirate's Daughter', before it's even written. How did we end up here?

1444: After his wife dies, a blacksmith named Balian is thrust into royalty, political intrigue and bloody holy wars during the Crusades.
Be without fear in the face of your enemies. Safeguard the helpless, and do no wrong

The year is 1766... The hunt for a killer has begun.

What you don't believe can kill you.

The damndest thing you ever saw.

A comedy for the incurably unromantic.

On the way to finding a family, she found love.

Destiny is what you make of it.
5284: A romantic drifter gets caught between a corrupt tycoon and his voluptuous wife.
I told you... you know nothing about wickedness

Need A Bounty Hunter? She's Your Man.

Self - Executive Director, Soul Force Ministry

No escape. No memory. 90 min to live.

His voice was the silence of death!

You'll see it tear a city apart!

Elvis Presley as a Roving, Restless, Reckless, ROUSTABOUT

Aranyhajú Nyárszépe / Ezusthajú Tavaszszépe / Rézhajú Öszszépe (voice)
Háromfejü sárkány / Hétfejü sárkány / Tizenkétfejü sárkány (voice)

Leave the faith. Pay the price

Murder, Conspiracy and the Masterpiece that Revealed the Truth

Invisible to anyone but Kay, he tries to prevent the wedding.

People are dying to live in this building.

17572: A young boy searches a future world wasteland for a rumored cure for his dying mother.

When her scariest secret revealed, you will be.

Husband of the woman in labour

What the cops can't do, he will.

If you want to survive, improvise.

The Bravest Warrior. The Ultimate Devotee.

A pig hunt in the middle of town.

Booster: Somebody who steals clothes from a store and sells them at a discount price, aka community service.

26276: Deportees is a 2007 Iranian film, written and directed by Masoud Dehnamaki, narrating a story during Iran--Iraq War.
26788: When a high school diploma becomes the key to unlocking his inheritance, a spoiled teen gets an invaluable lesson in life and love in a rural village.
You are the love that I dream of.

A surreal love out of nowhere…

He must fight off numerous clans who are all attempting to steal the book from him, to find out the true reason for the disappearance of the Shaolin Masters.
Master Chin the Black Dragon Gang

Heroes are not born, they are imported.

Please be quiet. Do not wake him up.

READY! SET! LAUGH! Join the fun in a nut-house of terror!

Balan K Nair/ Rocky K Nair

A story about a New York Chinatown waiter who falls for a college student.

Eve Ferrell / Young Arab Woman / Old Arab Woman

Just a small-town barber who became a "big-shot" gambler-riding high and handsome until he went balmy for a blonde!
